faultLoc.explanation: The NullPointerException occurs because `charsetEncoder` is null when `setCharsetEncoder` is called. The method `charsetEncoder.charset()` is invoked without checking if `charsetEncoder` is null. This line should include a null check before attempting to use `charsetEncoder`.

The `charsetEncoder` is initialized using `super.getCharset().newEncoder()`. If `super.getCharset()` returns null, this will cause a NullPointerException. Ensure that `super.getCharset()` never returns null or handle the null case appropriately.

The method `getCharset()` in `AbstractStreamBuilder` returns the `charset` field. If `charset` is null, it will cause issues when `newEncoder()` is called on it. Ensure that `charset` is properly initialized and never null.
This line sets `charsetEncoder` to the provided value, which can be null. Before setting `charsetEncoder`, there should be a check to ensure it is not null or handle the null case appropriately.
